summary.content:
Today's selection covers 62 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Close to Landing $500 Billion Data Center With Backing From Nvidia
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Coca-Cola Confirms Data Breach After Fairlife Ransomware Attack
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, TechCrunch, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 47 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: OpenAI Close to Landing $500 Billion Data Center With Backing From Nvidia
top.description: The chipmaking giant is in talks with OpenAI to provide a $250 billion financial backstop for the project, which would be among the largest of the A.I. boom.
